summary:
Our project is based on technology and modeling. It focuses on helping people understand the planet more deeply through various sensory methods and facilitates teaching and learning for all ages. The idea behind it is a practical, interactive website that includes data and statistics. It explores the Earth's relationship with the Sun and features illustrative images, audio clips, digital statistics, and a 3D model, all integrated into a single system. The website is designed to provide a wealth of information in one place, serving as an encyclopedia for a better understanding of our planet. The tools used in creating our project include GitHub repositories and the Gemini AI model. We also utilized NASA's Earth Database to analyze, compile, and categorize the data. Our project can be showcased in educational institutions and training centers for interactive learning.
This is the Bitta Team project. 
Thank you.
details:
The project offers a website that educates people interested in learning about planet Earth and its interactions, facilitating learning in a fun, smooth, and effective way. One of the benefits of our project is that it is suitable for all levels and ages. It is dynamic and creative. It is also suitable for anyone who wants to learn, as it is presented in a unique, interactive, and sensory way. It is organized into easy-to-understand paragraphs and main headings and includes a large amount of information in a format that is: Our project works across any browser, whether for sharing or keyword searching, and it is easy to access internal tabs. The user's browser displays data and information as a unified system, and it works on all devices. The programming languages ​​used are: Page Structure: HTML Design: CSS Interaction: JavaScript Files: Python

AI tools used: Gemini

Some of the challenges we encountered: academic studies, pressure, time constraints, categorizing information, and scattered files.
